mission: Han and Leia on a Coruscant terrace — the operational separation is named and agreed.
why_now: Both of them are ready to say it.
opening_hook: Han and Leia on a Coruscant terrace overlooking the Senate district at dusk.
conflict: Neither wants the separation; both know it is operationally necessary.
turning_point: Han says he will go to Corellia; Leia says she will keep the Falcon; neither of them asks the other to reconsider.
closing_hook: Han boarding a Corellian-bound freighter alone; Leia watching from the gantry.
setting: Coruscant terrace; then a Coruscant spaceport gantry, evening.
sensory_details: Terrace wind; spaceport's hangar lighting; the freighter's boarding ramp.
emotional_trajectory: Measured exchange → named separation → watched departure.

stakes.external: Han's alignment with Corellia becoming fully operational.

notes: Allston takes his time with the separation — no ultimatums.
